## Bug Fixes

- **Black WebUI fixed** — `autostart` used `[[` (bash-specific), but openbox runs it with `/bin/sh`. Replaced all `[[` with POSIX-compatible `[`. Container now starts reliably.
- **First-run timeout increased** — From 60 seconds to 5 minutes (150 × 2 s). Gives JDownloader enough time to download and install itself on first start.

## New Features

- **`JD_THEME` variable** — Replaces `JD_DARK_MODE true/false`. Theme name is now set directly (`JD_Plain_Dark`, `JD_Plain`, `JDDEFAULT`). Unraid template shows a dropdown with `JD_Plain_Dark` as default.
- **ASCII banner in init log** — A consistent "Junker der Provinz" banner appears in the container log on start. The `print-banner.sh` script is reusable across future repos.
- **`generate-assets.yml` workflow** — Automatically converts `icon.svg` to `icon.png` (256 × 256) via rsvg-convert. Unraid Community Applications requires PNG for icon display.

## Improvements

- **Template** — Removed `system` from the language dropdown (was an edge case with no practical use)
- **README** — `JD_THEME` updated throughout; first-run timeout corrected to 5 minutes
- **release.yml** — Now supports manual changelog files under `.github/release-notes/<version>.md`

## Upgrade Notes

Existing containers: **Force Update** in Unraid is enough. `/config` is left untouched.

If you had `JD_DARK_MODE=true` set previously: the template will update to `JD_THEME=JD_Plain_Dark` on next open — functionally identical.
